description: OMENZ Checkout (close): ONE call after paying. Send checkout_id + the tx hash (or PAYMENT-RESPONSE header) + the response you got. Verifies settlement on Base against the authorized payee and amount, checks delivery against the seller's advertised output, returns a signed Spend Receipt (GOOD_BUY / PAID_NOT_DELIVERED / PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED), gives the money back to the Shared Budget if you never paid, and updates the seller's track record. High volume: checkout/close/credit at 1% (min $0.0002). By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/checkout/close, $0.002 via x402.)
